Read all 32 lines. Reviewed the fixed package/version, dual NuGet sources, caller-controlled Platform/paths, recursive copy, and RemoveDir. The apparent public-feed dependency-confusion path is defeated for this package namespace by the nuget.org Prefix Reserved status and official Microsoft/dotnetframework ownership; the normal justfile caller also supplies only the Visual Studio feed. A local MSBuild probe showed RemoveDir unlinks a RestorePackagesPath symlink without traversing or deleting its target. No attacker-controlled source crossed into the copied executable under the resolved threat model.
